title: Vitamin B12 Deficiency
subtitle: Recognition, confirmation & clinical clues

sections.heading: Recognize the pattern
items: Neurologic findings may occur without anemia

sections.heading: Who is at risk?
items: Pernicious anemia or impaired intrinsic factor
Vegan diet, metformin or acid suppression

sections.heading: Confirm deficiency
items: Check CBC, vitamin B12 and folate
If B12 is 150–399 pg/mL, check methylmalonic acid

sections.heading: B12 vs folate
items: Renal insufficiency can also elevate MMA

callout: Do not treat presumed folate deficiency before excluding vitamin B12 deficiency—neurologic injury can progress despite hematologic improvement.
